name: Judgment Agreement
standard: When shown two outputs, Marvin should choose the one Leo would choose and give a compatible reason.
test: Score blinded A/B pairs against Leo adjudications; disagreements remain visible and become calibration material.

metric.name: creator_choice_agreement
metric.unit: share of blinded pairs where Marvin matches the recorded creator choice

claim_boundary: Agreement is not proof that the creator judgment is correct or stable.
